note: TOWN FOG, baked by gen/bake/bake.cjs from gen/bake/fog.ts (the old fogPrepJob's fields). A table (`tables`): one texel per fog cell of `cell` units from the place's top left (k = 1/cell), gw x gh, read by cell, never filtered; channels 0..255 stand for 0..1, a zone is its index in `zones` (255 none). a0..a2: the colour field's three strongest zones at the cell, R zone, G weight (the three sum to 1), B creep order from the zone's anchor. s0..s2: the same for the seen field (the same cells where it is not drawn apart). n: R, G the haze's two noises, B the rim mix. o: R the core zone (its walkable ground), G the map art (cave), B the haze weight (in the town the light's reach: its cover is 1 - B). t: R the stain front's step-cost noise, G its grain (one each for every zone), B (town) a street, where the stain's step costs 0.7 of the rest. `meets`, place units: where a zone's stain starts, `between` [zone, from, x, y] where zone `from`'s colour enters (the town's carry a head start, -80, and its blocks also start at 0 on their border with `from`, by `o` R), `own` [x, y] per zone where it starts with no neighbour, the town's `pit` [x, y, -120] where the lift's colour climbs out. The mine's warded dressing: `censers` per zone [x, y, pool r, core r] at rest (each swings sin(1.3 t + 2.1 k) x 4 in x; its pools, PAL.gold glow at (x - swing, y + 34), squashed 0.45, alpha 0.5 a, and PAL.gold base at (x, y - 2), hardness 0.25, alpha 0.7 a, each radius already kept off the rock), `chambers` per zone [x, y, rx, ry] (its rising motes). `anchors`: each zone's creep origin; seenFloor, seenSink, hazePow: the fog's constants for this place.
